@39tybs are you ok to add your test-case to the netty sources ? Also could you please sign our CLA ?
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheet/viewform?formkey=dHBjc1YzdWhsZERUQnhlSklsbG1KT1E6MQ
@39tybs I fixed it in 3.6.6-SNAPSHOT (please try) and 4.0.0.CR3-SNAPSHOT. The fix is a "modified" version of what you suggested.  But still would love to have your test included ;)
@39tybs I don't know yet if it fix the issue, but nice catch ! I didn't think about internal attribute...

Why you think it does not??

Am 14.05.2013 um 20:20 schrieb Frédéric Brégier notifications@github.com:

> @39tybs I don't know yet if it fix the issue, but nice catch ! I didn't think about internal attribute...
> 
> —
> Reply to this email directly or view it on GitHub.
I think it's fixed... So I will close it now. If the issue still persist please re-open

@normanmaurer Thanks for the quick fix. Works for me now.
I would be glad to provide the test class. But before I can sign the CLA, I have to check with my company, if this is ok. I don't expect any issues, but it might take a few days.

While I was spending some time on a possible improvement on both V3 and V4 version, I realize that InternalAttribute now is almost deprecated by definition in the code, while in fact it isn't.

@normanmaurer I understand that the default constructor should be deprecated, but why the other is and the same why the attribute value are marked as deprecated, I don't know...
It seems not consistent either with V4 where no deprecated are shown.
There is no arm but as warning are shown since the Encoder called the unallowed constructor, it might be better to fix this?
